chapter: Philadelphia, New York and Sam Wooding in Europe
title: Learning technique from an Argentine tango trumpeter in Biarritz
summary: At the Biarritz casino he went daily to a trumpeter with the Canaro tango band to pick up techniques.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Did you go out and listen to European music?

Yes, oh yes. I had a few instructions from trumpet players in Europe, at that time. That I heard were doing things that I wanted to know how, they were doing them. One fellow from Argentina by name of [Canaro,] he was over there with the famous Tango Band, called the [Canaro] Brothers. They had at that time the greatest tango band in the world. They were on the same bill -- same casino, Bellevue in Biarritz with Sam, we played at the same place.
Two bandstands and this trumpet player was out of sight and I would go to him everyday and get little things from him, that he was doing.
He wasn't a jazz, but he had a lot of techniques.
And I wanted to learn other things.
